senses.definition: vb. part, open wide (NH פָּסַק, Aramaic פְּסַק, ܦܣܰܩ, all cut, sever, cleave);—
Pt. פֹּשֵׂק שְׂפָתָיו Pr 13:3 i.e. one talkative.
Impf. 2 fs. וַתְּפַשְּׂקִי אֶת־רַגְלַיִךְ Ez 16:25 (c. ל pers.; sensu obsc.).
